intro: One bowl of bihun sup is roughly 300 kcal. Most of the calories come from the bihun. The clear soup and vegetables add almost nothing.
diet: Yes, bihun sup is one of the most weight-loss-friendly options at the stall. It's low in calories and the soup fills you up. Protein is only moderate though, so you might get hungry sooner. Add a protein side so you can last until your next meal.
tips: Add chicken, beef or fishballs for more protein.
Ask for extra vegetables like sawi and taugeh.
Go easy on the fried shallots and sambal kicap for a lighter bowl.

swap.name: Sup ayam with half portion of rice
swap.why: Higher in protein and still a clear, filling soup.

faq.a: Rice flour and water. That's why it feels lighter than yellow mee.

faq.q: Is bihun sup good when you're feeling unwell?
faq.a: Many people choose bihun sup when they're under the weather because the soup is light and warm. For health advice, please see a doctor.

faq.q: What's the difference between bihun sup and bihun sup tulang?
faq.a: Bihun sup tulang uses a soup boiled from beef bones. It's usually fattier and more spiced.
